email_followup.subject: Your Google Ads Audit + The $89/Call Problem You Probably Have
email_followup.purpose: deliver lead magnet + immediate insight that creates urgency
email_followup.body_hook: You just downloaded the audit. Before you open it, here's what we found in 9 out of 10 PI firm accounts we analyzed: they're getting 80+ calls/month from ads but only converting 35-40. That's 45-50 calls going to voicemail. At $89/call (industry average CPC for PI), that's $4K-$4.5K/month in the trash. The audit shows you if you're in that group.
email_followup.cta: Open the audit and run your Account Health Score (takes 3 minutes)

email_followup.subject: The Speed-to-Lead Metric Nobody Tracks (And Why It Matters More Than CTR)
email_followup.purpose: expand on one specific mistake and show your competitive edge
email_followup.body_hook: Most PI firms obsess over click-through rate. We obsess over something different: how long before someone picks up the phone. A criminal defense firm we worked with was averaging 45-second ring time. Their conversion rate was 18%. We got them to under 10 seconds. Conversion jumped to 43%. Same ad budget. Same traffic. Different system. Your audit probably shows your ring time (if you have call tracking). If it's over 15 seconds, that's your biggest leak—not your keywords.
email_followup.cta: Reply with your ring time (just the number). I'll tell you if you're in danger zone.

email_followup.subject: What $4K/month in Ad Spend Actually Looks Like When Optimized (Real Numbers)
email_followup.body_hook: A 2-attorney PI firm in our system: started at $5K/month ad budget, 18 calls/month, 3-4 signed cases. After audit fixes (call answering system, keyword cleanup, landing page changes), same $5K/month, 67 calls/month, 12-15 signed cases. 3 months. No increase in spend. The difference? They fixed the three things your audit probably flagged. We can show you the before/after on your account—not someone else's.
email_followup.cta: Book a 15-minute audit review (we'll walk through your results and show you the 3 fastest fixes)

promotion_posts.linkedin:
A PI firm spent $5K/month on Google Ads and got 18 calls.

They thought the problem was their budget.

It wasn't.

We installed call tracking.

The data: 67 calls came in that month. Only 23 were picked up. 44 went to voicemail, abandoned, or unanswered.

That's $3,916 in wasted spend on calls nobody answered.

Same budget. Different system. 3 months later: 67 calls, 52 picked up, 12-15 signed cases.

We just built an audit tool that shows you if you're bleeding money the same way.

15 minutes. You'll know your exact leak.

Free PDF — link in comments.
